data.title: Bug: `func-name-matching` ignores property names containing astral letters
data.titleHTML: Bug: func-name-matching ignores property names containing astral letters
data.body:
### What parser are you using?

Default (Espree)

### What did you do?

<details>
<summary>Configuration</summary>

```js
<!-- Paste your configuration here -->
```
</details>

```js
/* eslint func-name-matching: "error" */

obj.φ = function ψ() {}; // reported
obj.𐐨 = function 𐐩() {}; // not reported

obj['φ'] = function ψ() {}; // reported
obj['𐐨'] = function 𐐩() {}; // not reported
```


### What did you expect to happen?

All four assignments should be reported. `𐐨` is a valid identifier in ES2015+, and the docs say that property assignments are skipped only when the name "is not a valid identifier in the ECMAScript version specified in your configuration".

### What actually happened?

```
Function name `ψ` should match property name `φ`.
Function name `ψ` should match property name `φ`.
```

### Link to Minimal Reproducible Example

https://eslint.org/play/#

### Participation

- [x] I am willing to submit a pull request for this issue.

### AI acknowledgment

- [x] I did not use AI to generate this issue report.
- [ ] (If the above is not checked) I have reviewed the AI-generated content before submitting.

### Additional comments

_No response_
